features.note: Oak path is retained and VOS qualifies table/class paths within one source unit
Names, spans, attributes, type wrappers and default syntax are available without durable identity
Reference, optional, list and generic syntax are canonicalized without symbol resolution
Primary and unique shorthand plus simple bracket attributes are preserved
Explicit diagnostic until Oak exposes structured attribute groups and arguments

VFS + collect pass + resolve pass + cycle detection, pinned by the multi_document fixtures. Contract projection still rejects using declarations, so an import never feeds definition resolution, and the collected symbol table is not consumed by the contract API.

SHA-256 operation_id is generated in OperationProjection, and the schema and artifact fingerprints plus their evolution verdicts are pinned by the fingerprint_evolution matrix. A per-source-unit fingerprint field is not part of the contract envelope yet.
Oak projects service attributes and method signatures, and build_service_contracts resolves them against the authored operation bindings while rejecting any declaration that disagrees with the source
